scope: The Sqrt_Approx distance blocks of Teleport Process, Walk ProcessMovement, RadSiteClass::GetRadLevelAt and PlaceInfantryInCell, and the particle constructor velocity normalization and Normalized= state-AI advance, and Find_Nearby_Passable_Cell's pick nearest a target, on synthetic coordinates.
assumptions: Registers and scratch memory hold the coordinates the callers read just before each block (GetCoords results, the destination or step head, the particle source and target); no objects, cells or map are built
A scratch particle type record holds only Normalized= and FinalDamageState=; the particle only its type pointer and speed
The nearest pick starts from its frame as the candidate collection leaves it: counts, packed candidate arrays and the target pointer
